# Model specification: MODEL-ID

Status: proposed / verified baseline / exploratory extension.

## Question and requirements
List hypothesis and requirement IDs.

## Sources and derivation
Primary source, version, exact equation/page mapping and independent checks.

## State and dynamics
Fields, action or equations, constraints, sources, units, normalisation, metric/gauge conventions.

## Domain and boundaries
Space topology, regularity, singularities, internal boundaries, external confinement.

## Assumed versus derived
What is supplied? What could emerge? Which measured values calibrate the model?

## Observables and limitations
Energy, momentum, charge definitions, angular momentum, localisation, expected invariants.

## Feasibility
Scale mechanism, causal/well-posed evolution, stability considerations and known exclusions.

## Tests and decision
Acceptance checks, numerical error budget, compute budget, review decision and next stage.
